name: pixedwall
description:
a wallpaper engine for pixel artworks written from scratch in Rust using the windows API, and a parser/renderer for an animated image format commonly used by videogames from the 1980s.

(the image format is called ILBM and was used for pixel artworks that used color cycling, an old school technique for animating images)
